`importance` and `quadrature = TRUE` are two different corrections of the same approximation and cannot both be asked for. Adaptive Gauss-Kronrod marginalizes one scalar random intercept at a time; the importance correction reweights the Laplace Gaussian and takes any block dimension. Keep one

`importance` cannot be combined with REML = TRUE. The correction reweights the integral over the random effects only, and REML puts the fixed effects into that same integral, where the reweighting has no proposal for them. Use REML = FALSE

`importance` cannot be combined with frmtmb_control(profile = TRUE). Profiling moves the fixed effects into the inner Laplace problem, and the corrected objective has no inner problem left to move them into. Drop profile = TRUE

`importance` has no unfitted form: the proposal is the Laplace Gaussian at a conditional mode, and stopping before the optimizer leaves no mode to centre it on. Sample the Laplace objective instead (importance = 0)
